hook: Three real browsers, one tab, zero installs.

beats.say: Side by Side opens one web address in Firefox, Chromium and Epiphany at once, each a real browser running in its own Linux virtual machine inside your tab.
Each virtual machine runs on a Linux kernel compiled to WebAssembly, with nothing to install and no server behind the page.
You need a desktop with eight gigabytes of memory or more, and the first visit downloads about eight hundred megabytes for the three browsers.
